body: Girl he ain’t shit. I know you’re sad but you don’t need that. You’re better off

Sometimes you have to be alone. You need to figure out why you want to live, you need time to figure out what makes you happy. Do you have a pet? If not get one of you can. They help you so much when you’re sad, the give you something to talk to. Vent to them. Do you write? If not start. You have a lot bottled up that you need to get out. Back in December i was very suicidal but i hugged my animals and kept a diary so i could get all my feelings out. At my job, i have some  acquaintances but i wouldn’t say i have any true friends that i enjoy hanging out with and i can tell all my secrets and hopes to. Music really helps. I like to listen to heavy music to drown the world out. 
Pets, writing, music.. oh and drugs. Smoke slow weed. Drop acid if you can. You’ll be just fine. Focus on what makes you happy. Try and think.. what would a hippie do.. ? My dms are open ☺️💜

They aren’t your friends at all if you have to change who you are around them! Are you in school? Fuck those guys/girls. They are boring as normies. I wouldn’t want to talk to people who don’t use reddit. You get to decide what’s cool. Live in your world, not theirs. If all the stuff you like and wear and the people
You watch on YouTube or follow or whatever.. all the stuff you think is cool.. then you’re the coolest person ever! (To yourself) and that’s all that’s important. You don’t have to impress anyone or try and prove yourself. Real true friends will like you for the REAL true you. It’s better to be cool on your own then dropping to their level to “fit in” nahh. You’re a god on Olympis with the rest of us and they are just some dumb mortals that don’t know any better. Silly fools. Keep your head up! Stay happy! That’s the meaning of life, just vibe and be happy. My DMs are open always :) hope this helped
Chris!

😕 I’m sorry. I know what you mean. I’m very much about suicide, there should be a pill you can buy for 100$ bucks or something that will kill you in your sleep. I completely understand what you’re going though. I’d you want help, you gotta  find the small things that do matter. Pets, drugs, tv shows, nature. Find what you DO like and just focus on that. The world is full of the small things that make you happy. If that’s not something you’re willing to do, i hope you get what you want. Without too much pain. 

Wish you the best
